welcome: 🌟 Welcome to *Hela Bot*, {first_name}! Type /help to see what I can do.
help:
🦭 *Hela Bot Help*

Use /help <category> to browse commands: economy, admin, owner, support.
maintenance_mode: 🚧 Hela Bot is currently under maintenance. Please try again shortly.
permission_denied: ⛔ You need *{required}* access for this (you currently have *{current}*).

economy.daily_cooldown: ⏳ You already claimed your daily reward. Come back in {remaining}.
economy.work_success: 🛠️ You worked hard and earned *{amount} coins*!
economy.work_cooldown: 😴 You're tired from your last shift. Try again in {remaining}.
economy.pay_insufficient_funds: ❌ You don't have enough coins in your wallet for that.

⚠️ {target} has been warned by {actor}. Reason: {reason}
